package external

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/2comjie/nova/diff"
	"github.com/2comjie/nova/internal/diffgen/testdata/basic"
	pbBasic "github.com/2comjie/nova/pb/basic"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

func TestNamedTypesAndTimes(t *testing.T) {
	external := new(Model)
	external.SetState(basic.Running)
	if external.GetState() != basic.Running || external.Snapshot().State != int32(basic.Running) {
		t.Fatal("cross-package enum type was lost")
	}
	value := new(basic.Typed)
	writer := diff.NewWriter()
	value.InitLink(writer)
	instant := time.Unix(1700000000, 123456789).In(time.FixedZone("local", 8*3600))
	value.SetState(basic.Running)
	value.SetMode(basic.ModeActive)
	value.SetAlias(basic.StatusAlias(basic.Running))
	value.SetNumber(basic.IntAlias(12))
	value.States().Store(basic.Idle, basic.Running)
	value.History().Append(basic.Running)
	value.Flags().Store(basic.Flag(true), basic.Running)
	value.SetDelay(1500*time.Millisecond + 5*time.Nanosecond)
	value.SetWhen(instant)
	value.Times().Store("start", instant)
	value.Timeline().Append(instant)
	if value.GetState() != basic.Running || value.GetDelay() != 1500*time.Millisecond+5*time.Nanosecond {
		t.Fatal("named Go types or duration changed")
	}
	snapshot := value.Snapshot()
	if snapshot.When != instant.UnixMilli() || snapshot.Times["start"] != instant.UnixMilli() || snapshot.Timeline[0] != instant.UnixMilli() {
		t.Fatal("time must use millisecond timestamps")
	}
	if snapshot.Delay != int64(1500*time.Millisecond+5*time.Nanosecond) {
		t.Fatal("duration must retain nanoseconds")
	}
	replica := new(basic.Typed)
	replica.LoadSnapshot(snapshot)
	if !proto.Equal(snapshot, replica.Snapshot()) || replica.GetWhen().Location() != time.UTC {
		t.Fatal("named types or time failed to load")
	}
	value.Commit()
	sameMillisecond := time.UnixMilli(instant.UnixMilli()).UTC()
	if value.SetWhen(sameMillisecond) || value.Times().Store("start", sameMillisecond) || value.Timeline().SetValue(0, sameMillisecond) || writer.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("timezone or sub-millisecond differences emitted changes")
	}
	value.SetState(basic.Idle)
	value.SetWhen(instant.Add(time.Millisecond))
	value.Times().Store("start", instant.Add(2*time.Millisecond))
	value.Timeline().SetValue(0, instant.Add(3*time.Millisecond))
	update := value.Commit()
	body, err := proto.Marshal(update)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded := new(pbBasic.Typed)
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(body, decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replica.Merge(decoded)
	if !proto.Equal(value.Snapshot(), replica.Snapshot()) {
		t.Fatal("typed delta failed", decoded)
	}

	for _, codec := range []struct {
		name      string
		marshal   func(any) ([]byte, error)
		unmarshal func([]byte, any) error
	}{{"json", json.Marshal, json.Unmarshal}, {"bson", bson.Marshal, bson.Unmarshal}} {
		t.Run(codec.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			body, err := codec.marshal(value)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			restored := new(basic.Typed)
			if err := codec.unmarshal(body, restored); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !proto.Equal(value.Snapshot(), restored.Snapshot()) {
				t.Fatal("codec changed named types or timestamps")
			}
		})
	}
	jsonBytes, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var jsonFields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(jsonBytes, &jsonFields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var millis int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(jsonFields["when"], &millis); err != nil || millis != value.GetWhen().UnixMilli() {
		t.Fatal("JSON time isn't an integer timestamp")
	}
	bsonBytes, err := bson.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if raw := bson.Raw(bsonBytes).Lookup("when"); raw.Type != bson.TypeInt64 || raw.Int64() != value.GetWhen().UnixMilli() {
		t.Fatal("BSON time isn't an int64 timestamp")
	}
	value.SetWhen(time.Time{})
	replica.Merge(value.Commit())
	if !replica.GetWhen().IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("Go zero time became Unix epoch")
	}
	zeroJSON, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(zeroJSON, replica); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !replica.GetWhen().IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("JSON lost zero time")
	}
}
